monito.name: Monito del Monte
monito.fact: Unique marsupial from the Valdivian forests. Considered a living fossil.

araucaria.name: Araucaria Araucana
araucaria.fact: Ancient tree sacred to the Mapuche people. Its seeds (piñones) are ancestral food.

woodpecker.name: Magellanic Woodpecker
woodpecker.fact: The largest woodpecker in South America. Inhabits native forests of Chile and Argentina.

frog.name: Darwin's Frog
frog.fact: Endemic species that incubates its young in its mouth. Endangered.

fern.name: Giant Fern
fern.fact: Found in both Valdivian and Amazon rainforests. Can reach 5 meters tall.

orchid.name: Native Orchid
orchid.fact: Over 3,000 species in LATAM rainforests. An indicator of ecosystem health.

placeBased.title: The power of place-based learning
placeBased.subtitle: Real stories of students and educators creating science and technology connected to their territory:

story1.title: Rediscovering endangered native species
story1.desc: Curarrehue students used computer vision and moisture sensors to map ancient trees and catalog local medicinal fungi.

story2.title: Automated solar irrigation against seasonal drought
story2.desc: Design of solar-powered weather stations and micro-irrigation for school greenhouses, increasing yields by 40%.

story3.title: Protecting local watersheds and ecosystems
story3.desc: Educational communities created floating microcontroller buoys to alert neighbors of changes in river water quality.
